Differentially Methylated Regions (DMRs)

Analysis of genomic regions with statistically significant differences in methylation levels between experimental conditions.

DMR Summary

Metric Value Description
Control group control The baseline group (e.g. control or reference) that is subtracted from the test group (condition) to calculate the modification difference
Test group mutant The test group (condition) from which the control group is subtracted (i.e., test group minus control group)
Total regions 30597 Total number of regions or windows analysed for this DMR analysis
Mean context depth 12.1 Average methylation context depth in all regions
Mean number of contexts 66.3 Average number of methylation contexts in all regions

control__mutant : hmC

Source file: /expanse/lustre/projects/csd940/zalibhai/biomodal/modality/outputs_CHG/Results/gencode.vM25.mouse.cpg_shores.annotation/DMR_20260329_212352/DMR_hmc_control__mutant_20260329_212352.bed

Volcano Plot

This plot displays methylation differences between conditions (x-axis) against statistical significance (-log10 q-value, y-axis). Points further from zero on the x-axis represent larger methylation differences, with negative values indicating hypomethylation and positive values indicating hypermethylation.

P-value Distribution

This histogram shows the distribution of p-values across all analyzed regions. A uniform distribution suggests properly controlled statistical testing, while a peak near zero indicates the presence of statistically significant differences between conditions.
